newsitem.title: FRANCE: Strauss-Kahn says relations with Germany fine.
newsitem.headline: Strauss-Kahn says relations with Germany fine.

text.p: French Finance Minister Dominique Strauss-Kahn said on Thursday that France's relations with Germany were very important and both countries wanted the European single currency launched on the scheduled date.

Asked if relations with Germany were under strain at the moment, Strauss-Kahn said: "No. I think relations with Germany are very important, for our government and for Germany. Both of us want the euro launched on the date scheduled and we will do our best to do so." He was talking after briefing the Senate finance committee behind closed doors.
